messages:
maria: FYI OmniCart on dedicated-pool-42 is seeing a scale loop and 429s since ~03:10 UTC, customer complaining about latency and a big unexpected bill. attaching quick traces.
kevin: escalated from CS. they see many retries from their SDK and a burst of small requests around the same minute. says auth errors sporadic (401) then 429s. :grimacing:
ajay: Can you drop the service logs + autoscaler events? I want the scale history + allocation events.
maria: pasted logs below. autoscaler toggling between 4 <-> 1 instances every ~40s. requests per minute looks stable but per-instance qlen spikes. logs:
```
2026-03-17T03:09:58Z autoscaler: desired=4 current=1 reason="queued_requests>threshold"
2026-03-17T03:10:35Z autoscaler: scaled_up to 4
2026-03-17T03:11:15Z autoscaler: scale_down to 1 reason="low_cpu for 20s"
2026-03-17T03:11:55Z api-gateway: 429 tenant=omncart msg="quota_throttled"
2026-03-17T03:12:18Z auth: token_refresh failed tenant=omncart status=401
2026-03-17T03:12:50Z autoscaler: desired=4 current=1 reason="queued_requests>threshold" 
```
kevin: customer also sent a sample trace where client retries 3x and then drops leading to ASGs full of short-lived sessions.
lina: wondering if the cooldown is too aggressive. we recently changed cooldown to 30s for new allocator. that seems low.
ajay: Yep that matches. If cooldown < median time-to-full-warmup then autoscaler hears the burst, scales up, then because CPU is divided across many cold instances it looks low and it scales down again.
maria: Also noticed that when instances evaporate, the auth token refresh requests spike (our token service has a per-pool limit) -> 401 cascades to client retries -> more queued requests -> more scale churn.
ops-bot: @channel Incident flagged: customer-impacting, priority=P1. See /incidents/INC-2026-033.json
maria: Repro plan I ran locally: 1) small steady background RPS of 30rpm, 2) 1s per-request spikes of 150 requests for 30s every 90s -> reproduce scale loop in ~3 cycles. attaching k6 script snippet.
```
# k6 scenario
scenarios: {
  burst: { executor: 'constant-arrival-rate', rate: 150, timeUnit: '1s', duration: '30s', preAllocatedVUs: 50 },
  base: { executor: 'constant-vus', vus: 5, duration: '10m' }
}
```
ajay: Proposed immediate mitigations (short term):
- increase scale-down cooldown to 180s for dedicated-pool-42
- enable pre-warm / instance warmup policy (30s buffer before counting for scale-down)
- temporarily raise token service rate limit for that pool to avoid auth cascade
maria: I can roll the cooldown tweak and request a pre-warm flag for that tenant. who can adjust token limits? ops?
ops-bot: deploy-bot will need a config change. assign to infra team.
deploy-bot: I can push a config patch to autoscaler: {"scale_down_cooldown_sec":180} for pool-42, rolling over 2 mins. confirm?
ajay: Confirm. Do not change global defaults — limit to pool-42.
kevin: Please add a note for billing team: customer had amplified retries; they may request credit. tagging Lina for product/billing context.
lina: Acknowledged. We should capture request volume delta and the retry multiplier to estimate bill delta. Also check if rate-limit counters caused any billing misattribution.
maria: Rolling cooldown change now. I'll also attach the repro harness and console graphs to the ticket.
(1 minute later)
maria: cooldown bumped -> autoscaler events show no further scale_downs for 5m, requests served with slightly higher latency but no 429s yet.
ajay: Good. Next steps for medium-term:
- tune hysteresis: use smoothed queued_requests over 60s instead of instant sample
- add a minimum stable-window before scaling down when scale_up happened within last 5m
- add per-tenant token-refresh backoff to avoid auth thundering
- run 3-day canary with this tenant's profile on staging to verify cost impact
kevin: CS: will tell customer we applied a mitigation and we're monitoring. ask for any SDK logs they can share.
maria: Filing a follow-up doc with config diff + telemetry snapshots. If we need a permanent change we'll push a controlled rollout to similar noisy pools.
lina: For billing: if customer requests credit escalate to finance with the playback from 03:09-03:20 and note retries multiplier.
ajay: Also create an automation alert: if pool-level scale-up/down count > 3 within 5 minutes -> page eng-oncall. current alerting threshold is 10; reduce for dedicated pools.
maria: Thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated and attach postmortem after we confirm stability. :white_check_mark:
